name: micromouse-26-teaser
description: UCD ElecSoc Micro-Mouse '26 launch teaser trailer

scripts.render:preview: remotion render Teaser output/master-preview.mp4 --scale=0.5 --muted && node tools/finalise.mjs output/master-preview.mp4 output/micromouse-teaser-preview.mp4
scripts.render:final: remotion render Teaser output/master-final.mp4 --muted && node tools/finalise.mjs output/master-final.mp4 output/micromouse-teaser-final.mp4
scripts.build:all: npm run prepare-media && npm run audio && npm run render:preview && npm run render:final && npm run validate
